subject: Sample Field note
title: The dump that finally stuck
preheader: How a five-second capture stopped dying in the daily.
tease: How a five-second capture stopped dying in the daily.
paragraphs: You dump a thought on a walk. Later you need it, and the daily is a wall of bullets.
Atoms files the keepable line into its own note, with links that remember why, and leaves your words alone.
